result.title: RegNC-Mamba3: Shared Structural Feature Learning Using Non-Causal State Space Principles for Multi-Modal Image Registration
result.summary: The main challenge of multi-modal image registration is shared structural feature extraction with higher accuracy and lower computational complexity. Compared with a State Space Model (SSM), the State Space Principles (SSP) formulation of Mamba-3 uses a more accurate discretization with lower truncation error while maintaining linear complexity. However, vanilla SSP is designed for natural language processing (NLP) and is not directly suitable for images. To address this issue, we propose a novel non-causal SSP (NC-SSP) with shared structure awareness and develop a coarse-to-fine registration method named RegNC-Mamba3. First, NC-SSP is designed to eliminate the dependence of the integral computation on the scanning path. By combining relative-weight normalization with aggregation over all circular scan paths, NC-SSP constructs a globally hidden state without long-range decay, which provides a wider receptive field and higher efficiency than the original Mamba-3. Second, NC-SSP is modified to strengthen the extraction of cross-modal structural features. When computing hidden states and feature interactions, we construct complex-valued sequences in NC-SSP by applying learnable Log-Gabor kernels, with different orientations to each head for frequency-domain modulation. This improves the perception of shared structural information across modalities and increases both registration accuracy and quality. Experiments on VIS-SAR and VIS-IR demonstrate that RegNC-Mamba3 outperforms the compared detector-based and semi-dense multi-modal registration methods.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 RegNC-Mamba3，一种粗到细的多模态图像配准方法：以非因果状态空间原理（NC-SSP）对所有循环扫描路径做相对权重归一化聚合，构建不依赖扫描顺序、无长程衰减的全局隐状态，并用不同方向的可学习 Log-Gabor 核构造复值序列以增强跨模态共享结构特征。
AI.relevance_reason: NC-SSP 对多路径隐状态做全局聚合以摆脱扫描路径依赖、缓解长程信息衰减，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的并行/多路径更新与信息坍缩问题提供可核查的方法线索；但该工作面向像素级配准而非推理，状态是否可用于推理期生成需进一步判断。
